coot.who: skinny old backwoods moonshiner, a gaunt elderly hillbilly
coot.design: battered olive-brown wide-brim felt hat with a round crown, a long pointed snow-white beard reaching his chest, white bushy sideburns and moustache, big bulbous red nose, rust-brown work shirt with a few dark buttons and patches, a worn dark leather belt, baggy grey-olive trousers with a tan patch on the left knee, scuffed dark brown boots, thin bony arms with bare weathered forearms
coot.face: sunken cheeks, squinting suspicious little eyes under bushy white brows, a toothless sneer, deep wrinkles, ruddy leathery skin
coot.texture: old hillbilly, olive-brown felt hat, long white beard, red nose, rust brown shirt, grey olive trousers with tan knee patch, dark brown boots, empty hands, no weapon
